description_en: Queries the information about a DataWorks workspace
description_zh: 该接口用于查询一个DataWorks工作空间的详细信息
name: GetProject

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/workspace/list) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks 工作空间的 ID。您可以登录 DataWorks 控制台 (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/workspace/list)，进入工作空间管理页面获取 ID。

该参数用来确定本次 API 调用操作使用的 DataWorks 工作空间
parameters.name: id

AliyunResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the workspace belongs
AliyunResourceGroupId.description_zh: 工作空间所属阿里云资源组ID

Description.example: Financial analysis group project data development

DevEnvironmentEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the development environment is enabled. Valid values:

true: The development environment is enabled. In this case, the development environment is isolated from the production environment in the workspace.

false: The development environment is disabled. In this case, only the production environment is used in the workspace
DevEnvironmentEnabled.description_zh:
是否启用开发环境：

true 工作空间启用开发环境，支持开发与生产环境隔离。

false 仅使用生产环境

DevRoleDisabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Develop role is disabled. Valid values:

false

true
DevRoleDisabled.description_zh:
是否禁用开发角色：

false，开启开发角色

true，禁用开发角色

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the workspace

Owner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the workspace belongs
Owner.description_zh: 工作空间拥有者UserId，即阿里云账号ID

PaiTaskEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether scheduling of PAI tasks is enabled. Valid values:

true: Scheduling of PAI tasks is enabled. In this case, you can create a PAI node in a DataWorks workspace and configure scheduling properties for the node to implement periodic scheduling of PAI tasks.

false: Scheduling of PAI tasks is disabled
PaiTaskEnabled.description_zh:
是否启用PAI任务调度：

true 可以在DataWorks工作空间创建机器学习（PAI）节点，并按照节点配置进行周期性调度运行。

false 禁用PAI任务调度

Status.description_en:
The status of the workspace. Valid values:

Available

Initializing

InitFailed

Forbidden

Deleting

DeleteFailed

Frozen

Updating

UpdateFailed
Status.description_zh:
空间状态：

Available：工作空间运行正常
Initializing：初始化工作空间
InitFailed：工作空间初始化失败
Forbidden：手动禁用工作空间
Deleting：正在删除工作空间
DeleteFailed：工作空间删除失败
Frozen：工作空间欠费冻结
Updating：更新工作空间中
UpdateFailed：更新工作空间失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID，用于定位日志，排查问题
